mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.09% is below the historical median of 2.5%, compressing the risk-free rate and reducing the discount rate for equity valuation, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that increases the probability of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (above 0.1% rise) and year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases the risk-free rate and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% AND CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by housing starts above 1500 thousand units and residential credit above 550,000 million dollars), strong consumer spending drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1500 AND RSAFS > 550000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals a weakening economy, which increases the risk of recession and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 18500 billion dollars (2017 dollars) signals a recession, which increases the risk of equity market downturns and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 < 18500.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market mismatch that increases economic uncertainty, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% AND UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 0.5% AND UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that increases the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%.
